thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [PAGER] gpu-serving-prod tokens_pending > 12k in us-west-2. Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes. Paging oncall_sre.

oncall_sre: on it. joining channel. what's the surface impact?

Maria: queue depth started climbing at 02:11 UTC, sustained growth. Autoscaler errors show iam:PassRole denied when creating nodegroup for GPUs.

Leo: grabbed a log:
```
2026-03-15T02:13:40Z ERROR autoscaler: CreateNodeGroup failed: UnauthorizedOperation: iam:PassRole on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-node-role denied
    status code: 403
```

Eng Infra: This aligns with a least-priv policy push earlier today that added a Condition on the PassRole. Looks like the new condition prevents the cluster autoscaler IAM principal from passing the role.

oncall_sre: can we route autoscaler to an existing nodegroup that doesn't require the passrole? emergency fallback preferred.

Leo: yes — we have nodegroup `gpu-emergency-legacy` tied to an older instance profile. I can flip autoscaler preferred list. Doing now.

Eng Infra: Running patch: 
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap/autoscaler-config -p '{"data":{"preferred_nodegroups":"gpu-emergency-legacy,gpu-main-pool"}}'
```

incident-bot: :information_source: autoscaler preference updated. Attempting scale on gpu-emergency-legacy.

Maria: new nodes started provisioning but one failed with launch template mismatch; ASG still references old launch template version (v39).

Eng Runtime: Checking the failed instance logs — kubelet never registers because the AMI lacked the correct NVIDIA driver package. That AMI is part of v39. v41 has the driver.

Eng Infra: We can trigger an ASG instance refresh to align to v41, but that will cycle instances and temporarily reduce capacity. How many GPUs do we need minimum to keep customer-critical traffic?

Solutions Lead: We need at least 3 GPUs to keep latency SLOs for high-priority customers. Right now priority traffic is seeing higher tail latency and some timeouts on long-gen jobs.

Product Ops: Confirmed customers X and Y reporting degraded performance. Support tickets coming in. No complete outage but user-visible slowdowns.

oncall_sre: immediate mitigations: 1) scale down batch/noncritical GPU jobs, 2) prefer emergency nodegroup, 3) start ASG refresh. Do them in that order.

Leo: scaling down batch jobs now:
```
kubectl -n ml scale deploy batch-worker --replicas=0
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: batch-worker scaled to 0. GPU-util dropped ~10% within 60s. Queue ingestion rate improved slightly.

Maria: initiating ASG instance refresh to switch to v41: 
```
aws autoscaling start-instance-refresh --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-emergency-asg --strategy Rolling --preferences '{"MinHealthyPercentage":75}'
```

incident-bot: :information_source: ASG refresh started (id: ref-9f8e7d). ETA ~10m.

Eng Runtime: While refresh is underway, one node came up Ready with v41 and registered GPUs. Scheduler placed highest-priority pods there. Queue depth is decreasing but still above baseline.

Eng Infra: Also, I'm seeing some intermittent `RequestLimitExceeded` when trying to call IAM PassRole earlier; likely contributed to sporadic failures. We'll ask infra-ops to rollback the restrictive condition if refresh doesn't finish cleanly.

incident-bot: telemetry snapshot: tokens_pending 12.3k -> 5.1k after batch scale down and emergency nodes. P95 latency 1.2s -> 820ms.

Product Ops: updating customers: sending interim status message and letting account teams know. We're collecting trace ids for affected requests.

oncall_sre: target: keep queue <6k and P95 <1s. Monitor autoscaler logs for any further PassRole 403s. If ASG refresh fails or stalls >20m, escalate to infra-ops to revert the policy change.

Maria: ASG refresh 60% complete. No further PassRole 403s in autoscaler logs after we moved to the legacy nodegroup preference.

Eng Runtime: Re-enabling some batch workers at 2 replicas to let non-critical tasks proceed slowly.

Solutions Lead: post-incident action candidates: revert the tightened PassRole policy until we validate the deployment; add a fallback in autoscaler config to try known-good nodegroups on PassRole failure; add alerting to detect AMI/launch-template drift earlier.

Maria: capturing diagnostics to ticket INC-2026-3192 and attaching autoscaler logs, ASG refresh id, and IAM policy diff.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: incident marked mitigated. summary: autoscaler failed to create new nodegroups due to iam:PassRole restriction and ASG launch template drift causing AMI/driver mismatches. Actions taken: prefer legacy nodegroup, scale down batch jobs, start ASG refresh to v41, manual coordination for a rolling update, customer comms. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-3192

Product Ops: We'll draft customer-facing note and SLA impact assessment in the next hour.

oncall_sre: handing off to daytime oncall in 30m. Current state: queue ~4.8k, ASG refresh ongoing (eta ~4m), autoscaler stable. If PassRole 403s reappear, tag pages with "gpu-autoscale-passrole".

Maria: acknowledged. We'll maintain watch and be ready to rollback policy if needed.

incident-bot: :lock: thread archived to INC-2026-3192 after handoff.
